description: This file defines a generic Indexer class for managing indexed storage operations, including initialization, existence checks, adding/removing indices, reading/writing data, batch operations, and migration of indices, within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Indexer
classes.description: A generic class for managing indexed data storage, supporting operations like init, exists, index, deindex, clear, read, write, remove, readMulti, writeMulti, and migrateIndices.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the index list from storage.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the index.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Adds a key to the index if it does not already exist.

methods.name: deindex
methods.description: Removes a key from the index.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all indices and removes associated data from storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key from storage.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to storage under a specific key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes data associated with a key from storage.

methods.name: migrateIndices
methods.description: Migrates old indices to new format, removing outdated keys.
